hermite_curve.limits: Cubic curve with finite endpoint positions and parameter derivatives; ordinary XYZW control points.

parabola_curve.limits: Positive focal distance; local coordinates (t^2/(4*focal),t); caller supplies orthonormal axes and finite bounded domain.

hyperbola_curve.limits: Positive semi-axes; one hyperbola branch (a*cosh(t),b*sinh(t)); bounded parameters must avoid floating-point overflow.

helix_curve.limits: Circular helix; pitch is axial distance per full turn; finite bounded angle domain; STEP uses a separately error-checked spline approximation.

spiral_curve.limits: Planar Archimedean spiral r=r0+slope*t; strictly positive radius over the domain; STEP spline approximation has measured error.

three_point_arc.limits: Three distinct noncollinear 3D points; arc passes through the middle point; absolute degeneracy threshold 1e-20 on squared cross product.

interpolate_curve.limits: Natural cubic interpolation through 2..11 finite points, uniform parameters; <=31 poles; not chord-length or periodic interpolation.

curve_reverse.limits: Reverses parameter domain and first derivative; second derivative is preserved; base kinds 0..6.

curve_length.limits: Composite five-point Gaussian quadrature of speed; positive panel count and regular finite base curve required; numerical estimate, not certified adaptive integration.

resample_curve.limits: Numerical arc-length inversion by bisection, fraction in [0,1]; regular nonzero-length base curve; fixed integration work bounds accuracy.

closest_point_curve.limits: 128-interval coarse basin selection plus golden-section refinement and endpoint checks; approximate nearest point, not a global proof for arbitrary oscillatory/self-crossing curves.

planar_offset_curve.limits: Regular planar curve with nonzero plane normal; left offset normal=cross(normal,tangent); returns a point, not offset derivatives; no self-intersection cleanup.

solid_sphere.limits: Positive radius; GPU definition/mesh and exact analytic CPU B-rep topology; orthonormal right-handed frame.

solid_ellipsoid.limits: Three positive radii; affine-transformed exact spherical B-rep represented as rational surfaces; GPU faceted preview is separate.

solid_cylinder.limits: Positive radius/height; closed analytic side and planar caps; local axis Z=cross(X,Y).

solid_cone.limits: Positive base radius/height, one apex; closed exact conical B-rep.

solid_frustum.limits: Positive radii/height; fixture uses unequal radii; equal radii should use cylinder rather than OCCT cone builder.

solid_torus.limits: Ring torus major>minor>0; exact native toroidal B-rep, separate GPU preview mesh.

solid_capsule.limits: Positive radius/cylinder height; hemispherical ends, exact revolved CAD profile and bounded GPU latitude mesh.

solid_prism.limits: Regular polygon prism, integer sides 3..64; positive circumradius/height; exact planar CAD faces.

solid_pyramid.limits: Regular polygon base with centered apex, sides 3..64; exact planar CAD faces; not a general arbitrary-base pyramid.

solid_wedge.limits: Positive sizes and 0<top_width<width; one sloped side, rectangular bottom/top and trapezoidal end faces.
